title: Utillian 721 / 722 – Care Package
description:
Compatible with all 7 series Utillian vaporizers

Keep your Utillian 721/722 fresh and clean with the Utillian Care Package.

A replacement pack if your screens and o-rings have started to degrade from use.
This kit comes complete with a set of 3 screens, 3 mouthpiece o-rings, 3 magnetic cap o-rings.

Compatibility
• Utillian 721/722

Package Contents
•5x Screens
•2x mouthpiece O-Rings
•2x magnetic cap O-Rings
